review_context.annotation_completeness: VIRAT Release 2 object tracks are not exhaustive background truth; the visible moving utility vehicle and partially sign-occluded pedestrian are not covered by the official track in this window.
review_context.label_policy: A crop dominated by an identifiable single road vehicle is vehicle. A partially occluded but visually identifiable single person is ped. Ambiguous crops would be ignore.
